newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh's Rahima food corporation goes public.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh's Rahima food corporation goes public.

text.p: Rahima Food Corporation Ltd (RFCL) has offered 67 million taka worth of ordinary shares at 100 taka each to finance its expansion programme, company officials said on Wednesday.
Subscription of shares begins on April 2 and closes on April 10, they said.

RFCL is an edible oil refinery group with a fully automated and computerised plant. "We have been consistently profitable since the start of operation in 1991, with margins which have been higher than the industry average," one official said.
He added: "The purpose of the issue is to go to the general public...and raise funds for the proposed expansion."

The officials said the company would set up vanaspati and bottling plants. They said out of the 670,000 ordinary shares 502,500 had been offered to the general public, 100,500 shares to the state-owned Investment Corporation of Bangladesh (ICB), 33,500 to company employees and 33,500 to non-resident Bangladeshis.
Besides, 330,000 shares have already been subscribed by five foreign firms including Peregrine Brokerage Ltd of Hong Kong.
